doc.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021

title: Seeing the Basie band as a boy
summary: Back to his parents' Basie dance, he recalls them taking him to hear the Basie band with Thad Jones, Snooky Young, Benny Powell and Frank Foster.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well this has been a fascinating conversation and I’m very pleased that your mother and father met at a Count Basie dance.

Yeah. They took me to see Basie too, the band with Thad Jones and Snooky Young and our great Benny Powell and Frank Foster, Frank Wess, and you know, Freddie Green and all those cats. It was great man.
